method: GameSession.start -> fixed-step public InputFrame and DraftIntent -> win/loss/public menu exit; no state or clock injection.
strategy: Migration choice rotates pursue/block/ignore. Odd seeds discard protocols; even seeds choose legal deterministic drafts. Public-input post-core rescue revisits unhealthy activated organs.
limitations: Headless deterministic simulation is not a real browser or human playtest.
A driver loss/exit is not proof that a seed is impossible.
Configured base counters and real input availability are checked; these runs do not separately execute every counter on every trait.
No frame-rate or 10-minute device-performance claim is made.
